```yaml
name: Harness Drift Report

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  drift-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run repo drift check
        run: npm run drift-check

  report-generation:
    needs: drift-check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Generate drift report
        run: npm run generate-report

      - name: Upload report artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: drift-report
          path: reports/drift-report.pdf
```
